status_at_freeze: Source definitions, gene-set sizes, selected source-table rows and prior five-gene atlas results inspected. No multi-gene atlas program score, paired program contrast or new experimental concordance summary inspected.
purpose: Reproduce source-defined ETS2 perturbation patterns and evaluate donor-level program context/specificity in the existing PSC liver atlas.
metadata_rules: Reuse pinned previous prepare_metadata, preserving exclusions, original author labels and separate donor/assay/modality strata. All stored raw counts checked. No PSC-Control or PSC-PBC expression comparison.
unit: donor within dataset, assay and author cell type; repeated libraries combined, sc/sn never counted as independent replication

programs.meaning: Genes downregulated by ETS2 gRNA1 editing; source-defined ETS2-dependent program

programs.role: biological comparison; not a mechanistically exclusive negative control
biological comparison; not a mechanistically exclusive negative control
biological comparison; not a mechanistically exclusive negative control
biological comparison; not a mechanistically exclusive negative control

programs.derivation: Subtract after exact atlas feature mapping; mapping coverage gate uses the parent source set. Report source and mapped overlap explicitly.

mapping: Exact stable Ensembl IDs after removing numeric version suffix only; otherwise exact unique raw/var feature_name. Record all missing and ambiguous identifiers. No aliases or expression-based signature membership selection.
normalization: Sum all-feature UMIs per donor/stratum; CPM=1e6*geneUMIs/allFeatureUMIs; log2(CPM+1). All intended mapped genes retained including measured zeros.
signature_coverage: Report intended/mapped genes, unique overlap, genes with any UMIs, and fraction detected per donor/stratum. Do not turn non-detection into absence of the pathway.

matching.reference: Per feature, average log2CPM1 across eligible20-cell author populations within each donor, then across donors with equal donor weight, separately by modality.
matching.universe: All unique raw features, including zeros; order by reference abundance then stable feature ID and split with numpy.array_split into20 equal-count bins.
matching.pool_exclusion: Union of all eight original mapped program memberships plus ETS2.
matching.seed_rule: int(sha256(f"20260912:{dataset_key}:{program_id}".encode()).hexdigest()[:16],16), numpy default_rng PCG64. Sorted candidates; draw bins in ascending order for each replicate.
matching.sampling: Match the mapped program gene count in each expression bin, without replacement within each set; samples reused across donor groups and at50-cell threshold. Sets may share genes across replicates.
matching.failure: If any bin lacks enough non-program genes, leave matched score and calibrated contrast unavailable; do not widen bins or replace missing controls. Unmatched program mean remains descriptive.
matching.calibration_limit: Controls match average expression only, not variance, gene length, detection, co-regulation or cell function. These are conditional gene-set references, not independent donors or disease-null samples.

score: Mean mapped-program log2CPM1 minus mean of1000 expression-matched random-set means for the same donor/stratum. Report unadjusted program mean and matched background separately. Negative scores do not mean biological inhibition.
conditional_percentile: Fraction of matched set means <= observed program mean; descriptive calibration, no population p-value or significance label.

contrasts.role: primary within-PSC cell-state contrast; whole-cell only if nuclei lack ActMac

contrast_summary: Within identical donor and assay compute left score minus right score; require3paired donors. Report median, full range, positive count; leave-one-donor-out medians only where at least3pairs remain. No p-values.
correlations: Within each author population and modality at each threshold, Spearman primary-program score versus ETS2 log2CPM1 and each of four biological comparator scores. At least4donors; constant vectors unavailable. Descriptive only; no significance or proof of incremental predictive value.
specificity_limit: A score or correlation cannot identify ETS2 dependence, causal mediation, or distinct activity beyond correlated inflammation. The nonoverlap sensitivity removes shared genes but not co-regulation.

experimental_benchmark.primary_source: Publisher Supplementary Tables S1 and S2; original source set definitions and rank files preserved separately.
experimental_benchmark.endpoints: On exact shared unique genes: descriptive Spearman of signed t statistics (and logFC where both available), gene counts and direction concordance. For primary source gene set, report available fraction, median signed statistic/logFC and fraction negative/positive in each experiment.
experimental_benchmark.rank_orientation: Use exact numeric agreement with publisher tables or an explicit saved-file-producing code path. Unresolved vector signs are unavailable for directional claims; report source-audit evidence and never select sign to match expectation.
experimental_benchmark.independence: g1-derived gene-set effect in g1 is circular source reproduction. Guide/dose comparisons share a study and may share donors. Gene count is not donor count; no gene-as-independent-replicate p-values.
experimental_benchmark.scope: No LINCS drug screen, treatment ranking, donor-level DE refit, spatial reanalysis or patient response simulation.

deliverables: All nine programs, mapped/absent genes and overlaps, matching-bin QC, donor-level aggregate context summaries, planned paired contrasts and correlations with missingness, experiment-summary benchmark, reproducible methods, figure and report. Donor expression, full matrices and sampled random-set indices remain ignored.
not_in_this_phase: No personal sequencing or individual-genotype inference
No researchers contacted or controlled-access application
